items.markdown:

```video

```

items.title: Floating statics
items.markdown: A floating static route has a higher administrative distance.

items.front: Synthetic card 1: what does the administrative distance of a static route default to?
items.back: One (card 1); a floating static route uses a higher value so the dynamic route wins.

items.question: When would you use a floating static route?
items.modelAnswer: As a backup path that only installs when the primary dynamic route is lost.
